routerClosed.description:
The agent offers no session/close, so the Router closed the
session itself: it interrupted the turn and released the session,
and the agent kept no close of its own (D1 R14).

oneOf.description:

finished and carries no reply of its own; the reply belongs to that turn.

turnApprover.description:

request named: a steered message's work is approved by the turn's.

ListCursor.description:
Where a list page continues: a position and the direction it continues in.
Oldest-first continues strictly after the position, newest-first strictly
before it; without a position the page starts from that direction's end.
Callers start with [`ListCursor::start`] and otherwise hand back the
`next_cursor` of the previous page.
